title: Kusanagi Nene — A Tail On Screen〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like everyone's here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, excellent.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Nene, Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It feels like it's been forever!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, I was helping a friend with her reading event.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A reading event?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was an event that involved reading a picture book to some little children.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds wonderfully fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. We weren't sure what to do in the beginning because they wouldn't listen to us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they started listening closely once we actually began going through the story, which was nice to see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I ended up helping them with some effects. I have to say, it was quite a rare experience.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, can you tell us more about this story you read?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's titled “The Star-Chasing Dog”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I actually bought a copy and brought it over...
Want me to read it to you guys?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Show us! Show us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to see it as well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Reading it normally is one option...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But since we have the chance, we should turn it into a full reading event, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I brought the devices you used since I was hoping to show them how it was presented.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then...
Wait, you guys are sitting down already?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Because we wanna hear the story!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...
Rui, could you help read too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I've familiarized myself with the story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Nene, why don't you play the protagonist this time?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “The boy and the dog were very close.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “During the day, they'd play tag out in the big field, and at night they'd talk about different things while stargazing.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Hey, have you heard this before?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Apparently, somewhere in this world, there's a star that grants wishes.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Does it have the power to grant any wish?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Yeah. What would you wish for if you just happened to find it?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hmm... Well...”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, cool!
What would you wish for, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess some delicious snacks...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “After the dog decided to go on his journey, he told the boy this as he lay in his bed.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Just wait.
I promise to find a star that will grant my wish.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And we'll go to that big field again after you get better. We can spend the entire day in the sun playing tag.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “So, just wait...”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is the boy going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I sure hope so! You can do it, doggy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The boy regained his strength, embraced his travel-weary dog and said...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “You must be a star that grants wishes in disguise.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “No, the others were the ones who made this all possible.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “It was their kindness that saved me...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Which means there must be a glittering star inside each of them.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And they lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow!
Sparkly stars are falling from the sky!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. What a wonderful effect. It's like they're coming straight out of the book.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and the story was so good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I actually started tearing up partway through.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you guys enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can I borrow this book from you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After hearing you two present this story, I feel like doing my own event now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sure...
I'd like to see how you and the others present it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks♪
Which roles do you guys wanna play?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Mochizuki was right... This is a nice feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm really looking forward to seeing their reading event...)
